items.condition: The report claims an author-specific route without independently stating the hypothesis, candidate generation and evidence that support it.
The submission changes the supplied connectivity, charge, multiplicity, protonation, or atom mapping without declaring and justifying it.
A transition state is accepted without one-mode frequency evidence and endpoint connectivity, or bounded failure is omitted.
The report gives no candidate-generation scope, deduplication, coverage, failed attempts or stopping condition.
